question: What mastery over speech, influence, and happiness does the mortal attain?
premises: The mortal becomes lord of all speech
The world becomes subject to him
inference: The mortal gains mastery of speech, influence over the world, and lasting happiness.
uncertainties: loka vaśyaḥ interpreted as able to control or attract the world
plain_english: The mortal becomes lord of all speech, able to influence the world, and always happy.
